card.name: Dollar amounts in country economic facts
card.fires_on: Dollar signs and the first digits right after them, in web text about countries' economies such as GDP, poverty lines, aid or fees. Also the closing bracket after a USD or World Bank label.

modes.label: Dollar sign before a figure
modes.description: The $ sign or first digit of a US dollar amount in a country statistics or economy passage.

modes.label: GDP table entry
modes.description: The point just before a number in a GDP table labelled in USD or World Bank.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward American and US words, such as 美国 and American.
